answer: Each of 226 aliases needs its own mooring chains, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The canyon is the wall and the ripple is the gate: A canal boat licence tenure with mooring renewal chain works as the gate: moorings renewed at one canal for years. A farm of 226 aliases must climb the wall 226 times, the quill ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
